Oneliner

Demonstrate receiving ADS-B signals emitted by aircraft and camera.
Description

Perform research and experimentation in space related to Software Defined Radio (SDR) with emphasis on receiving ADS-B signal from commercial aircraft over oceanic areas. As a secondary payload the satellite flies a NanoCam C1U colour camera for Earth observation experimentation. Track trans-oceanic flights by reception of the ADS-B signal signal emitted by aircraft.
